author: StraightG0lden
body:
I can answer some of those. 

The balance really isn't that great until tier 10 with summoner and valhallan class lines being significantly stronger at from tier 7 through 9. I personally used valhallan to level because it's a lot faster, but summoner is the easiest and safest class to use if you have the time. At tier 10 when you get your class geared every class line is viable and the Gilgamesh has one of the best skills (spiked shield) making warrior a really strong choice. 

For leveling raids is one option, but you can get just as much experience doing world bosses when you're able to one-shot them and beat them in rapid succession. Leveling with my valhallan I'm not sure which follower I used at tier 8, but at tier 9 I know the Crimson Gazer is capable of one-shotting every regular boss for quick leveling. Doing quests from the adventurers guild was another good option when I was leveling, I'm not sure how well it works since they've changed it.

Raids were pretty miserable for me until tier 10 too. The problem is the summoner pretty much is the only viable class for it because the summons can take the damage instead of you, but you're not dealing enough damage to beat them in a reasonable amount of time. All I can say on that is that it gets better later and every class line has options to do them easily when you get there. I use a Towerfall build with my Beowulf (which means nothing to you yet, I know) and I can handle most raids in a minute or two with no trouble.

Memories are the easiest orn farming choice until you get gear specifically for it. At T8 you're able to get the questing weapons from a dragon's den which significantly increases orn drops, then there's the mimic head and other things that raise them. Don't feel bad about spending them on another class line because later you'll want every class unlocked anyway for access to all of the skills.

author: petr1petr
body:
the issue is, that summoner classline is broken.

it is way too easy class, so other classes may look like they are weak - they are much more difficult and require some knowledge. Unlike summoner.

Summoner has not been around since the game started - it has been added later. so doing content with other classes is perfectly OK - may look hard, but thats ok - you just need to get stronger. Check on skills, builds, find out why do you use this and that. you should have some knowledge about how is dmg calculated, how defenses work.. 

so yeah, the design is OK, the game was made with "normal" classes, but later on, they added summoner, who is supereasy to play, so other classes now look weak.

btw - reading your post, I noticed, that you are missing huge part - this game is MMORPG - you can play with others - that will answer some of your questions.
